T0675.title: Privileged Account
T0675.definition: A privileged account has high-impact capabilities such as system administration, configuration changes, sensitive-data access, or permission grants.
T0675.description: Privileged accounts include operating-system administrators, database administrators, cloud root accounts, network-device administrators, and application service accounts. Their compromise or misuse can bypass ordinary permission boundaries, enabling configuration changes, data export, log deletion, and persistence, so they require dedicated governance, least privilege, and continuous auditing.
T0675.usageExample: The security team places root, DBA, and cloud administrator privileged accounts in a password vault and records each approved session.
